subject.title: docs(agents): add ops telegraph notes for CI dispatch, release logs, and shared checkouts

question: Do these seven operational rules accurately reflect the current CI, release-validation, formatter, and shared-checkout procedures and belong in the root agent guide?
rationale: The patch deliberately records operational policy rather than executable behavior; only maintainers responsible for those workflows can confirm that these instructions should become repository-wide hard rules.

options.title: Confirm and merge
options.body: Keep the focused root-guide additions after refreshing the branch against current `main`.

options.title: Narrow or relocate rules
options.body: Move any rule that is not repository-wide or no longer reflects current workflow ownership to the relevant scoped guide or workflow documentation.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge
recommendation.body: Keep the focused root-guide additions after refreshing the branch against current `main`.

likelyOwner.reason: The author supplied the concrete operational context and is the available routing candidate for clarifying the intended root-guide rules.
